2. On due consideration, so also the reasons assigned in the application, I.A. is allowed.
Delay in filing the appeal is, hereby, condoned.

3 . Shri Nitin Gupta, learned counsel for the claimants submits that he has paid deficit court fees of Rs.11,050/- vide Online Court Fee ID No.306243/2023 dated 15.12.2023 and prays for permission to amend the valuation.
In support of the said submission he has filed a copy of Online Court Fee ID No.306243/2023 dated 15.12.2023

, therefore,
prayer is made that the Court fee may be taken on record.

4. This appeal under Section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988, is filed by the appellants being aggrieved of award dated 05.07.2022, passed by learned II Additional Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Seoni (M.P.), in MACC No.80/2020, on two grounds, firstly, deceased Aditya Rahangdale,
who had met with an accident on 14.09.2020, was aged about 17 years and at the time of accident,
his notional income is taken by learned Tribunal at Rs.40,000/- (Rupees Forty Thousand) per annum, whereas, minimum wages even for an unskilled labourer on the date of the accident were to the tune of Rs.8275/- (Rupees Eight Thousand, Two Hundred and Seventy Five) per month or Rs.99,300/- (Rupees Ninety Nine Thousand and Three Hundred) per annum.
